report_comment.text: BRD4 encodes a bromodomain-containing chromatin-associated protein. NUTM1 encodes NUT family member 1. BRD4::NUTM1 binds large hyperacetylated chromatin megadomains. Primary chromatin experiments showed colocalization with p300 and increased transcription within these domains in NUT carcinoma cells and engineered cells. NUT carcinoma is clinically aggressive. In a retrospective 124-patient cohort, nonthoracic BRD4-fused tumors had worse survival than nonthoracic BRD3/NSD3-fused tumors, while thoracic disease had the poorest outcomes.
